# Overview

A two-file module that greets. The static surface is small and lives in
`src/`: [greet](../src/greet.ts "c2d:src/greet.ts#greet:d8d678d808e29df0.e25615d447c0fabf")
builds a greeting from a name, while [Greeter](../src/greet.ts "c2d:src/greet.ts#Greeter:ff8c388155116962.6b4c8d8f5cfc9e4b")
stores one and echoes it back.

- Public interface: [src module](modules/greet.md)
- Dynamic behavior: [greeting flow](flows/greeting.md)
